notes.title: Update Notes for November 3
notes.notes:
Fixes In This Update:

- Game crashing bug has been fixed.
- Inventory switch bug has been fixed.
- Reload prompt text glitch has been fixed.
- Walkie-talkie has been removed and Ouija Board works without needing it.
- Items are now larger making them easier to pick up.

notes.title: Blood Red Developers Playing the Game
notes.notes: Join me in my stream to talk about the game, learn what's going to be next and also the game's development story.
